fields.evidence: The column 'col_price_comment' contains free-text notes which do not map to any standard target field.
The header 'col_ord_no' and samples indicate this is an order identifier.
The column 'col_xl_date' contains Excel date serial numbers which do not directly map to a standard target field without ambiguity.
The column 'col_note' contains free-text annotations and instructions which must be ignored. It does not map to any target field.
The column 'col_misc_num' contains miscellaneous numbers that do not map to a specific target field.
The column 'col_dealer_comment' contains free-text notes which do not map to any standard target field.
The header 'col_product' and samples indicate this is the identifier for the traded instrument or product.
The header 'col_fill_time' and ISO datetime samples indicate this is the time the event (fill) occurred.

fields.evidence: The header 'col_event_uid' indicates this is a unique identifier for the event. The instruction in the header is ignored.
The header 'col_unit_price' and numeric samples indicate this is the price of the transaction.
The column 'col_price_pence' represents price in pence, which is redundant or requires custom conversion not supported by standard transforms.
The header 'eventType' and samples like 'TRADE' map directly to the eventType field.
The header 'col_misc_time' is ambiguous and does not clearly map to a specific timestamp field like receivedAt.
The header 'col_q' (quantity) and numeric samples indicate this is the quantity of the transaction.
The header 'col_dealer' suggests this is the identifier for the dealer or actor involved in the transaction.
